snippet.title: Heavy Metal Death Can - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Classic Survival Horror Emerges from the Depths

Heavy Metal Death Can is a retro-inspired survival horror game set on a submarine in an alternate 1970s Sweden. With fixed camera angles, tank controls, and choice-driven gameplay, it channels the tense, cinematic style of late ’90s horror. Players must balance ammo, health, and risk in a world where cozy Swedish cultural staples clashes with cold industrial brutality and deep sea horror. Modern visuals meet nostalgic design to create a fresh yet familiar horror experience.

Will you make it back home? 

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726370/Heavy_Metal_Death_Can

Music Credits:
Ouroboros - Argos Eye
